# authwise_guard_resource_node_groups (Resource)

The node groups that serve a Guard resource, by full name (`authwise_guard_node_group.<name>.name`), as an authoritative set: every member of a group serves it, including nodes that join the group later. The nodes that serve it by name are `authwise_guard_resource_nodes`; the two sets are separate and may be used together.

A translated resource (`authwise_guard_resource.translated`) is served only by nodes that report `app-translate`; a group with a member that does not is refused (`NODE_LACKS_CAPABILITY`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Prometheus in the cluster, served by every replica of the cluster's
# connector. Translated: clients reach it at its published name, so another
# cluster may serve the same cluster address.
resource "authwise_guard_resource" "prometheus" {
  tenant_id      = "t-01"
  network_id     = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  display_name   = "Prometheus (gfk)"
  kind           = "application"
  address        = "prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local"
  translated     = true
  published_name = "prometheus.gfk.office.acme.guard.authwise.com"
}

resource "authwise_guard_resource_node_groups" "prometheus" {
  resource    = authwise_guard_resource.prometheus.name
  node_groups = [authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_connector.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_groups` (Set of String) Full resource names of the associated node groups.
- `resource` (String) Full resource name of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the resource's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_resource_node_groups.prometheus tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/resources/res-01
```
